proves.claim: with claim.checkCeiling on, a strict baseline that is pending or has no seconds is refused CHECK_UNSOUND and the item stays open and unclaimed.

cli.io-claim.check-strict-refuses-unsoun.why: Without it a strict check that promises a measurement is claimed with none, and unproven work passes.

proves.claim: an item whose baseline has no strict field is still claimed while its remeasure is pending.

cli.io-claim.check-strict-claims-non-str.why: Without it the strict refusal could block ordinary items that are merely awaiting a remeasure.
